summary: Two manual test runs 11 minutes apart. build.py keeps the later one.
Premium and Pluss read as zero (100% Basis) for two weeks: package classification failed, the market did not change.
For-sale and upcoming shared one key and were averaged. Migrated 2026-08-31; history is now correct, no action needed.
A second job (vend-codes) once wrote decoy rows into the same keys for finn.no and blocket.se. The exported history reads clean.
Four categories shared one key and were averaged (about a quarter of the true total). History rebuilt by migration; no action needed.
Dealer series NULL for 53 days: the results header was relabelled to 'Viser: N leasingbiler' and the parser missed it.
Package sample raised from 5% to 10%: sampled counts double from this week. Shares are comparable across the break, counts are not.
Price history starts here: older price-monitor snapshots had already been pruned when the permanent history table was added.
finn rate-limited the package crawl (HTTP 429): 3,850 listings against a ~22,000 norm.
Job counts NULL: a client-side render race on the large results page. Fixed by waiting for the counter.
New-build series starts. finn.no real_estate_homes is USED homes only, on purpose; do not sum the two by default.
DataDome blocks the scraper and robots.txt disallows the path. Only two manual observations exist; the series is not tracked.
Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403) on the filtered page; new listings NULL three nights.
Cloudflare challenges intermittently NULL either hemnet count (2026-09-26 and 2026-10-06 to 10-08).
All 8 finn_jobb prices read 10 000 kr on 2026-10-02 and reverted on 2026-10-03: a calculator placeholder, not a price change. Both days are excluded; the net change is zero.

Upstream outlier filter (all-time mean ± 3 std dev) blanks genuine values on trending series: biltorvet.dk cars private and blocket.se mobility_other private since 2026-10-06. Raw values are kept in facts/listings.csv with quality_flag=outlier.
